description: Node clue library. p = private (patron whisper), r = recap (narration, past tense), c = contact (spoken). Slots resolve against the frame.

entries.p: Odd things began near {site.clue} a few nights ago, and the old folk will not talk about them.
entries.r: Folk near {site.clue} had begun to leave their doors unlatched and their lamps lit.
entries.c: Strange doings near {site.clue}; I have been watching.

entries.p: Animals have been leaving {region.short}, and nobody can say what scared them.
entries.r: The animals had been leaving the district without a sound.
entries.c: Even my dog will not walk west of {site.clue} now.

entries.p: Three people have dreamed of the same dark room, and each woke up with the same name on their lips.
entries.r: Three villagers had dreamed of the same dark room.
entries.c: Dreams are spreading faster than any rumor.

entries.p: Someone who {v.sig} is behind this, and the {v.title} is the name they use.
entries.r: The attackers wore no marks, yet whoever sent them {v.sig} and is called the {v.title}.
entries.c: The {v.title}, they call them. The sort who {v.sig}.

entries.p: Every trouble has the same hand in it: the one they call the {v.title}.
entries.r: Every strand of the trouble pointed to the {v.title}.
entries.c: I have heard of the {v.title}; trouble follows that name.

entries.p: I found a mark I know: the {v.title} was here before us.
entries.r: A familiar mark showed that the {v.title} had been here first.
entries.c: That mark is the {v.title}'s. They have been here longer than we thought.

entries.p: I overheard a plan to {v.scheme}. It is already underway.
entries.r: A scrap of paper in the attacker's pocket described a plan to {v.scheme}.
entries.c: They mean to {v.scheme}. That is why all this matters.

entries.p: The stolen things all fit one purpose: to {v.scheme}.
entries.r: Everything that had been stolen fit one purpose: to {v.scheme}.
entries.c: Add it up and the answer is clear: they mean to {v.scheme}.

entries.p: The {v.title} is not after gold. They want to {v.scheme}.
entries.r: It became clear the {v.title} was not after gold but meant to {v.scheme}.
entries.c: The {v.title} is not a thief. They want to {v.scheme}.

entries.p: Every trail ends at {site.stronghold}. I have seen the carts go in.
entries.r: The trail ended where every trail ended, at {site.stronghold}.
entries.c: They are working out of {site.stronghold}; I have seen the lights.

entries.p: There is a door behind {site.stronghold} that is not on any map.
entries.r: A map found among the attacker's things marked a door at {site.stronghold}.
entries.c: You will want to look at {site.stronghold}. Quietly.

entries.p: A guard talked in {home.name}: the answer lies at {site.stronghold}.
entries.r: The word came together at last: it all led to {site.stronghold}.
